subject: Action items: Marketplace private-offer unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — follow-up from discovery
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action items: Marketplace private-offer unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — follow-up from discovery

Sanjay — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook for the marketplace private-offer mapping across AWS, GCP and Azure.

Call recap (30m):
- Use case: real-time inference for customer analytics dashboards; peak ~90M tokens/month, steady ~12–18M/month.
- Priority: predictable unit economics in marketplace listings so finance can reconcile MRR and pass-through.
- Constraint: Nimbus procurement requires a single unit price per 1M tokens per cloud listing (Marketplace private offer).

What we need from Nimbus to move to a draft private offer:
1) Confirm target committed volume band for the private offer (monthly committed tokens, or 12‑mo commitment). You mentioned a conservative starting band of 10–20M/mo.
2) Confirm target list price or acceptable $/1M tokens range for approval from your procurement/finance team.
3) Any regulatory or audit requirements per region that affect contract language (we noted EU data residency for a subset).

What Redwood will deliver for the PO draft:
- A mapping table that converts Redwood internal unit price (per 1M tokens, model-adjusted) to a marketplace line-item price for AWS/GCP/Azure private offers and the pass-through mechanics.
- Suggested target $/1M tokens per cloud (we will show a reference band and a reconciled net-to-RNWD unit price after marketplace fees).
- Draft private-offer doc (attached: RNW-priv-offer-mapping-draft.pdf) and a token forecast template (attached: Nimbus_Monthly_Token_Forecast.xlsx).

Proposed next steps / owners:
- Nimbus: confirm committed band and procurement contact (Action: Sanjay) — by EOD Wed (2027-08-18).
- Redwood Sales: produce marketplace mapping and suggested price bands for each cloud (Action: Ben) — deliverable by Fri 2027-08-20.
- Redwood Legal/Finance: prepare private offer template and include pass-through reconciliation notes (Action: Jonas) — target draft by Mon 2027-08-23.

Target metric we discussed: a gross target in the ballpark of $60–$90 per 1M tokens as a starting reference (we'll show net-to-RNW after marketplace fees). If Nimbus has a firm target outside that range, please flag — we will adjust the mapping.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the committed band and procurement contact and then Ben will send the mapping table.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments: RNW-priv-offer-mapping-draft.pdf (pdf), Nimbus_Monthly_Token_Forecast.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-08-14T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action items: Marketplace private-offer unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — follow-up from discovery

Thanks Mina — useful summary. A few clarifications from my side:

- Confirmed volumes: team comfortable committing to a 12‑month PO with initial committed band of 12M–25M tokens/month (start Q4 ramp). We will likely sign for US-only initially, then add EU in Q2.
- Procurement contact: procurement@nimbusanalytics.com (CC'd). They asked for a single per-1M unit price per cloud listing (we understand AWS/GCP/Azure will each have a private offer line item).
- Target price: procurement wants a starting cap of $75 per 1M tokens (they'll accept up to $90 if we can justify throughput/latency guarantees).
- Marketplace fees: they asked us to propose the gross listing price such that their internal P&L shows ~5–8% markup vs the pass-through cost.

Attached a first-pass token forecast (shared in Drive). Procurement also asked for a simple formula in the offer that shows:
  marketplace_line_item_price = gross_price_per_1M_tokens
  net_to_redwood = gross_price_per_1M_tokens - marketplace_fee - marketplace_commission

We want Redwood to propose the gross listing price per cloud so we can review with procurement — ideally with a table that shows both gross listing price and net-to-RNW.

I can confirm procurement's preferred cadence for PO (they want monthly reconciliation, invoice net-30).

Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships | Nimbus Analytics
sanjay@NimbusAnalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Action items: Marketplace private-offer unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — follow-up from discovery

Mina / Jonas — quick internal note and the proposed mapping table approach I will send as an attachment by EOD. Summary of proposed numbers (first pass):

Assumptions from today: committed band 12–25M tokens/mo (US launch). Marketplace fee estimates: AWS 15% fee, GCP 12% fee, Azure 14% fee (these are ballpark—will annotate).

Proposed gross listing price (per 1M tokens) and expected net to Redwood:
- AWS: gross $88 / 1M -> estimated net to RNW $75 (after marketplace fee & commission)
- GCP: gross $84 / 1M -> estimated net to RNW $73
- Azure: gross $90 / 1M -> estimated net to RNW $76

This gives Nimbus procurement the gross listing in the $84–$90 range, which maps to their target ~$75 net-to-RNW. It also leaves room for a small procurement markup per their ask.

Action items for me:
- Produce a single CSV that shows mapping per cloud, include a scenario table for committed tiers (12M, 18M, 25M) and the blended effective $/1M tokens after expected marketplace fees.
- Include a short note on how Redwood handles model variant fallbacks (if Nimbus routes to a higher-cost model we will surface the token delta on invoice).

I'll attach the CSV + short explainer. If this looks good, Jonas can include the numbers in the draft private offer.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: RNW-marketplace-mapping-20270815.csv (csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@NimbusAnalytics.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: 2027-08-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Action items: Marketplace private-offer unit-price mapping (AWS/GCP/Azure) — follow-up from discovery

Thanks team — this is a good starting point. A couple notes from Legal/Finance POV:

1) We should explicitly list which party is responsible for marketplace fees in the offer language — Redwood recommends including marketplace fees in the gross listing and showing the net-to-RNW in a reconciliation appendix. That aligns with Nimbus procurement's request to see net-to-RNW.

2) For invoicing: we'll draft the private-offer so Redwood invoices Nimbus for the net-to-RNW amount monthly and Nimbus receives a single marketplace invoice if required by marketplace flow. We will coordinate invoice formats during the contract signature stage.

3) Target $/1M token confirmation: Jonas endorses Ben's mapping as conservative and suggests we present two scenarios to procurement — a base scenario at $75 net-to-RNW and a stretch scenario at $68 net-to-RNW (higher committed volume).

Next steps:
- Ben: finalize CSV + scenario table (Action: Ben) — today EOD.
- Mina: schedule a 30m prep w/ Nimbus procurement to walk the mapping (Action: Mina) — propose Tue 2027-08-17 or Wed 2027-08-18.
- Sanjay / Nimbus procurement: confirm whether they want a single cloud-agnostic price in the PO or cloud-specific line items (Action: Sanjay / procurement) — by Wed 2027-08-18.

Jonas Weber
Head of Finance Ops (acting) | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
